test_title: PYST 114: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 12 Jan, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c8a95ac320c54b1297cb3359efe77c516d7a294ece2fbca9b5813ea53d106be.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: 'Shaded Diamond' is getting shifted to its next place in each image.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70e9169707369c45062f753b70d2f522f7cf3ec4d6a5628834b92aeb7938cc1b.png] 

Step II: 'Diamond' is getting shifted to its next place in each image.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cfcfc171c0b236b226a2a142e771124afeb49666baf5d7e75c0ba4f19b4b0f7.png] 

Step III: 'Circle' is getting shifted to its next place in each image.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/632b3e3d8ea0365367e4ec1401da0648349e440da652fd7966b48a0d47935fa7.png] 

Step IV: The 'Sqaure' is getting shifted to its next place in each image.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbe3ceec8e27abee885fc23169df59e145a2cf0543e17f25d8617a23f5270530.png] 

Step IV: The 'Shaded Sqaure' is getting shifted to its next place in each image.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/223eabab070fe1ba5b9f6954176ee5ec0b5ba9d9447e4b03a6fc860130df8423.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e44f83e3284668cf95d9d0af8924176dba90b6ded134f0ef950c325e090b2b7.png] 

So, 'Option 3' will replace the question mark.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
